title: Handspring website, 2000
lede: Handspring’s home page in August 2000, led by a large photograph of a translucent blue Visor.
summary: A translucent blue Visor on a textured blue swoosh, light serif VISOR heading, and rounded lilac tab headings.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. Nothing covers the page. All images loaded.

styles.note: Borderline: the translucent candy product and the rounded tab shapes carry the style; the page around them is a plain white table layout. The page draws its graphics with images, so the CSS fingerprint measures flat, square, unshadowed boxes (see the style page). Judge it by the rubric.

observed: A large photograph at upper left shows a translucent blue Visor at an angle, with round silver buttons, on a blue textured surface that curves away in a swoosh.
“VISOR” is set in large serif capitals that fade from pale blue to dark blue; the tagline “whatever the heck you want it to be.” is in small blue sans-serif.
Three columns start with lilac tab bars whose ends are rounded: “places to go”, “things to buy”, and “news to know”, with the last word in heavy blue.
Product teasers pair small photos (an orange Visor, a thin modem, colored styluses, a leather case) with light lilac headings.
Small orange “GO” circles and square lilac and green buttons act as controls. A blue textured swoosh closes the layout at the bottom.
interpretation: The site sells the object that carries the style: the [Visor](ref:handspring-visor-deluxe-2000) in translucent candy colors. The page shows the product photo as the hero and repeats its blue and rounded shapes in the tab bars.
Measured: no CSS gradients, shadows, or radii; the pixel palette is mostly white with a strong blue accent.
borrow: Use a product photo on a curved band of color as the page header, and echo the curve in the footer.

images.alt: Archived Handspring home page: a translucent blue Visor handheld on a curved blue textured band at top left, a large VISOR heading and tagline, and three columns under rounded lilac tab bars with product photos and news links.
